compiled_state.description:
## Why this idea exists

Operator decision 2026-08-05: the inert `CodeHealthConfig.analyzers` knob is being DELETED
(bug dce2-b93d-4112-451c) rather than wired up, because it advertises a capability that does
nothing today. This idea preserves the capability's intent so the deletion is not a loss of
information.

## What a real implementation would need

The analyzer FRAMEWORK already exists and shipped -- the interface plus hard Unavailable
fallback (story 3b30-2168-ba16-41fc), and adapters for size/LOC via scc (18f9), complexity
via lizard (21fb), and duplication via jscpd (3ba0). What never existed is per-project
SELECTION: `_config_schema.py` grew an `analyzers` field and a coercion row, but
`_commands/metrics.py` only ever consumed scan_roots / size_cap / size_near_fraction and
never read it.

So the work is not "build analyzers", it is "let a project choose which analyzers run".

## The operator's explicit condition on doing this

Do NOT re-introduce the selection knob as configuration alone. It must ship together with
DOGFOODING: at least one project-specific analyzer that rebar itself selects and runs through
the knob, proving the seam end-to-end on a real analyzer rather than on config plumbing.
That condition is the whole reason the previous attempt rotted into an inert field.

## Suggested acceptance shape when this is promoted out of idea

- A project can select which analyzers run, and the selection is actually read by the metrics
  pipeline (a test proves a deselected analyzer does not run).
- At least one project-specific analyzer exists, is selected via the knob, and produces a
  real metric for this repository.
- An inert-config guard covers the new field so it cannot silently regress to zero read sites
  (this is the 281f / 9d7a inert-config family, and the 6754 gate's read-via marker).
compiled_state.title: Per-project analyzer selection, shipped with at least one dogfooded project-specific analyzer
